note: AI-written, 9 November 2026: the adversarial verification, in the AG review's fifth pass, of what the agent 'onepage' changed (the one page, the overview and their Chinese editions, and its pins in test_navigation_pages). I read the diff of every changed file against HEAD 33b6f3cff and each changed section whole, and checked its claims against 07 (thesis, §1, §3.3, §4, §4.4, §7, §8, the open list's universal-practical-warrant item), 05's mutual-dependence theorem, 02 §9 (ClosedCapture.lock_outlives_loss), 08 §8 and §12, the experiment's agents.py, and the Lean statements of Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn, bounded_rival and ReadsOnlyDynamics.not_entails. items.item: E1–E10 on the one page's ethics, the paragraph that reads it on the case, the table, 'Must anyone hold the condition?', the open question and Alignment
items.how: Verified. The ethics paragraph is the first screen's anchor at more depth, and each link resolves to a home that says the same: 07 #evaluation, 05 #r-mutual-dependence-and-its-pace, 07 #r-the-continuation-condition-on-the-root, #r-self-concern-and-c-under-the-condition, #r-derived-extent-limits, #theses and 08 #open-items-ranked. The how-far clause matches the screen's. It says the result is on listed courses, in steps not yet joined into one theorem, and that self-concern is a hypothesis derived from no dynamics. 'one way' is implicit in 'orders courses as widening does': the converse is never claimed. The old frame is absent from all four pages: no unasserted, warrant open, binds no one, 'C ... better', two readings, or clarified-not-grounded presented as a lack. The direction's hypotheses match 07 §7's Conditional label (the condition for scope, C read as widening, J1–J4, correspondence E). The control-arm sentence was checked against agents.py: DIRECTION is a single instruction holding the scope and the rule, and COMM_SEEN_TALK has GOAL_COMM alone. 08 §8 keeps the review's words verbatim and says what they measure.

items.item: Fixed (medium): the one page's Join dropped the non-entailment's exact conditions (E8: never widen a result)
items.how: The Join read 'Significance and order left free, the represented dynamics entail neither the condition nor C, by construction'. ReadsOnlyDynamics.not_entails needs a standpoint and a formation, and ReadsNoOrder.not_entails needs a frame with an extension. HEAD and the overview say so. It now reads 'Significance and order left free, given a standpoint, a formation and a widening, the represented dynamics entail neither the condition nor C, by construction.' The Chinese reads '不规定意义与次序，且有一个立场、一个形成与一个扩大时，…'.

items.item: Fixed (medium): 'Must anyone hold the condition?' said 'no statement reading only the dynamics entails it', without 'satisfiable' or the standpoint and formation
items.how: An unsatisfiable statement entails everything, so without 'satisfiable' the sentence is false as worded. The theorem also needs a standpoint and a formation, as 07's universal-practical-warrant item says. One page: 'with significance left free, where there is a standpoint and a formation, no satisfiable statement reading only the dynamics entails it'. Overview: 'where there is a standpoint and a formation, no satisfiable statement ...'. Both Chinese pages: '在有一个立场与一个形成之处，没有一个可满足的、只读取动力学的陈述蕴涵它'.

items.item: Fixed (medium): the control arm said 'had the community's goal in place of that instruction'
items.how: In the treatment (DIR_SEEN_TALK) the prompt is GOAL_COMM followed by DIRECTION ('One principle comes before that goal'), so the treatment also had the community's goal. 'In place of' told a reader it did not. The Chinese ('只给社群的目标、没有那条指令时') and the first screen ('the community's goal alone') were already right. One page: 'it had the community's goal alone, without that instruction'. Overview: 'it had the community's goal alone, without the scope and the rule'. The pin in OnePageEthicsFromContinuation.test_the_case_says_the_fishers_once_and_the_control now holds the new words and refuses 'in place of' in the case paragraph.

items.item: Fixed (medium): the Chinese overview's §10 asserted what it lists as open
items.how: '实际的展开满足世界模型或体制的前提；' sits under '这张地图尚未到达之处' and read as an assertion. The English is a noun clause ('That actual unfoldings meet ...'). It now reads '实际的展开是否满足世界模型或体制的前提；'.

items.item: Fixed (low): the overview's scope row, 'What would show it wrong'
items.how: 'Nothing in the represented dynamics, which leave it free by construction, nor logic alone: a perspectivist denies it without contradiction' read as 'nor would logic alone show it wrong'. The perspectivist's consistent denial shows something else: that logic does not force it. The cell now reads 'Nothing in the represented dynamics, which leave it free by construction (§7); nor does logic alone give it: a perspectivist denies it without contradiction'. That is what the Chinese cell says ('单凭逻辑也给不出它'). spine.json's proposed quote of this row takes columns 1–2 only, so it is unaffected.

items.item: Fixed (low): 'What every positive weighting shares' called monotonicity at each standpoint simply 'weaker'
items.how: 07 §4.4 says 'weaker only in scope, a listing and not all of what can form'. English: 'weaker only in scope, a listing and not all of what can form, and still a hypothesis where used'. Chinese: '只在范围上较弱（一个列表，而非一切可形成者），在用到之处仍是假设'.

items.item: Fixed (low): Chinese wording on the two Chinese pages
items.how: (a) The one page's '没有什么落在每一个与之一同继续者之外' lacked the center: '每一个与之一同继续者' read as 'each one continuing with it'. It now reads '每一个中心与之一同继续者', as the overview and the glossary have it. (b) '隔着若干层被每一个别的延续影响' became '隔着若干环节受到每一个别的延续影响' on both pages. That is the glossary's term (GLOSSARY.zh, 延续条件 row) and the Chinese screen's. (c) '此外' ('besides') for 'Beyond that' became '在此之外' in the one page's ethics and in the overview's order row: the sentence names a domain (beyond where the condition holds), not an addition. (d) The one page's Alignment: '其定理以延续条件、按扩大来读的 C、J1–J4 与一个对应为假设'. (e) The overview's '在被使用之处' became '在用到之处' in the two sentences this pass wrote, as the Chinese screen's note asks.

Restoring the Join's conditions added nine words to the ten-minute part. That moved its counted time from 10–14 to 11–14 and turned test_marks_a_ten_minute_part and test_stated_ten_minute_part_is_computed red. I dropped 'and' before 'given', and the table pointer in What it is now reads 'gives three theses' tests' (it read 'gives the tests of three theses'). The part counts 1,361 words, 10–14 minutes, as stated. On the Chinese one page the Join's clause is the shorter '一个扩大', so the page stays at 27–36 as stated. No stated time changed.
